stewards.name: OpenAI
stewards.role: Founding maintainer, TSC seat 1; runs ChatGPT, the main ACP agent surface.

stewards.name: Stripe
stewards.role: Founding maintainer, TSC seat 2; co-developer; Shared Payment Token is the first compatible Delegate Payment implementation.

implementers.name: ChatGPT product discovery (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Agent surface ingesting merchant feeds through ACP; Target, Sephora, Nordstrom, Lowe's, Best Buy, The Home Depot and Wayfair named on 2026-03-24. On 2026-10-20 OpenAI's merchant page said shopping is live for US users, applicants wait on a waitlist, and a self-serve merchant platform is planned later this year.

implementers.name: ChatGPT plugins (formerly the Apps SDK) external checkout (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Users finish on the merchant's own checkout; generally available, with approval currently limited to plugins for physical goods (2026-10-20). OpenAI's merchant page says there are no fees for purchases made on the merchant's site or app.

implementers.name: ChatGPT plugins checkout with saved payment methods (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Documented on 2026-10-20 as a third path: the plugin shows only payment methods the customer already saved with the merchant, and the customer confirms in ChatGPT. It cannot collect new credentials, which need the payment sheet. The page gives it no availability label.

implementers.name: ChatGPT payment sheet (OpenAI)
implementers.role: In-chat payment sheet in ChatGPT plugins (formerly the Apps SDK), a private beta for select marketplace partners; PSPs Adyen, Checkout.com, Fiserv, PayPal, Stripe, Worldpay.

implementers.name: ChatGPT Instant Checkout, 2025 form (OpenAI)
implementers.role: In-chat ACP checkout launched with US Etsy sellers on 2025-09-29; scaled back in March 2026.

implementers.name: Stripe (Shared Payment Tokens, Agentic Commerce Suite)
implementers.role: Delegate Payment implementation (SPTs, preview) and the Agentic Commerce Suite for agents (private preview), which Stripe says works across multiple commerce protocols. Stripe keeps a protocol page each for ACP and UCP and names UCP in its seller guides for merchant-run checkout (2026-10-20).

implementers.name: PayPal
implementers.role: Announced it will adopt ACP and run an ACP server for its merchants; CLA signed 2026-04-16.

implementers.name: Microsoft Copilot Checkout
implementers.role: Launched 2026-01-08 saying it adopts open standards like ACP; later merchant page requires a UCP-compliant feed.

implementers.name: Walmart
implementers.role: Announced Instant Checkout plans on 2025-10-14. On 2026-03-24 OpenAI said a Walmart app in ChatGPT with account linking, loyalty and Walmart payments was available in web browsers, with iOS and Android to follow; Retail Dive reported the same on 2026-03-25.

implementers.name: Shopify (Shopify Catalog)
implementers.role: Product data reaches ChatGPT through Shopify Catalog with no extra merchant work; Shopify's VP of Product, quoted by OpenAI, said purchases complete on the merchant's store through an in-app browser. OpenAI's merchant page says Shopify and Etsy catalogs are already integrated with no setup or application (2026-10-20).

implementers.name: Target app in ChatGPT
implementers.role: OpenAI announced the Target app in ChatGPT on 2025-11-19, launching in beta the following week, with multi-item baskets and checkout through the user's Target account. Target was also named for ACP product discovery on 2026-03-24.

implementers.name: Etsy app in ChatGPT
implementers.role: Reported live in beta on 2026-05-05 (Retail Dive, 2026-05-14, citing Etsy's product chief): users tag Etsy in a prompt and click through to Etsy to buy. Etsy sellers were the first ACP Instant Checkout merchants in 2025; OpenAI's merchant page lists Etsy catalogs as already integrated (2026-10-20).

implementers.name: Corporate CLA signatories (Adyen, Wix, commercetools, OpenCommerce Network, Affirm, Agentic Commerce Inc.)
implementers.role: Contributors under the CLA; signing is not evidence of a live integration.

sdks.name: agentic-commerce-protocol

sdks.name: @agentic-commerce-protocol/specification (package.json only)
sdks.note: Repository validation scripts; not published on npm (404 on 2026-10-11).

sdks.name: acp-sdk
sdks.note: Not ACP: this is IBM's Agent Communication Protocol SDK. Listed only to prevent confusion.

metrics.caveat: Context only; not an ACP usage metric.

costs.value: No fees for purchases made on the merchant's own site or app
costs.whoPays: Nobody beyond the merchant's own PSP fees
costs.caveat: OpenAI's merchant page as read on 2026-10-20; the page cannot be dated (Wayback copies are JavaScript shells). Its FAQ says there are no fees on purchases that start in ChatGPT and that OpenAI is moving away from a standalone Instant Checkout experience, with purchases completed on merchant-owned sites or apps.

costs.item: ChatGPT Instant Checkout platform fee (2025 form)
costs.value: "A small fee on completed purchases"; no rate published
costs.caveat: OpenAI's wording at the 2025-09-29 launch; free for users. History: the in-chat Instant Checkout was scaled back in March 2026, and OpenAI's merchant page now says there are no fees for purchases completed on the merchant's own site or app (2026-10-20).

costs.item: Reported fee for Shopify merchants on ChatGPT checkout sales (2026-01-21)
costs.value: 4 percent of the sale, on top of Shopify fees
costs.caveat: History: PYMNTS relaying The Information and a Shopify spokesperson in January 2026; not published by OpenAI, and the in-chat checkout it referred to was scaled back in March 2026. The same report said Google and Microsoft charged no extra fee for now.

costs.value: Set per Participating Channel in Shopify Admin; the terms print no rate
costs.caveat: Shopify's Agentic Storefronts Supplemental Terms (last updated 2026-10-06), section 6.1: Shopify may assess a fee for certain channels, on top of subscription and transaction fees, collected by the payment processor. The terms do not say which channels carry a fee.

costs.value: No protocol fee; Apache-2.0; no fee for TSC or working group seats
costs.caveat: Costs come from platforms and PSPs, not the spec.

costs.value: 0.15 USD per SPT issued (Stripe's US pricing page)
costs.whoPays: Not stated; Stripe prices it per SPT issued
costs.caveat: Listed since at least 2026-04-23, the first archived copy that shows it. The pricing page does not name the party billed; its Learn more link opens the agent variant of the SPT docs, which still carry preview terms (API version 2026-09-30.preview) and show no price. Stripe's Canadian pricing page lists CA$0.20 per SPT issued (2026-10-21).
Card economics are unchanged because the merchant charges the payment.
